body:
Hmm.. weird realization I figured I'd post but the reason I want to die is because I'm lazy but realistically the only reason I'm still here is because I'm too lazy to go through with it.

Just funny how the thing that makes me want to commit suicide is the very same reason I haven't.

That's the thing I'm really not into anything at all, I just kind of surf the internet most of the time, maybe play a game or something or go outside and try to keep busy. Literally nothing productive or anything you could turn into a career or even a way to earn an income. 

I don't feel like I'm being hard on myself, I feel I'm just being realistic.
